newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's November CPI +0.6 vs +0.8 pct in October.
newsitem.headline: Israel's November CPI +0.6 vs +0.8 pct in October.

text.p: The Central Bureau of Statistics issued the following economic indicator: ISRAEL
CONSUMER PRICES Nov 96 Oct 96 Nov 95 Month-on-month
Note: To compare previous indices based on 1987=100.0, multiply indices from January 1994 by 2.421.
The November index was at the upper end of estimates and was apparently raised by a sharper-than-expected one percent increase in housing prices. Food and clothing prices also led the November CPI.
The wholesale price index was also up 0.6 percent for the month. Wholesale prices have lagged retail prices over the last year, with the index rising 7.2 percent.
